title: Skin 契约无关硬化：失败重试、2D 预览组件与缺口补录
objective: 在不触碰公共契约的前提下完成三项硬化：①渲染与清理 worker 的 BullMQ 重试/退避配置与死信验证（testing.md 必测不变量）；②可测试的 2D 像素预览组件与解码纯函数（为 3D 替换保留接口；数据源接线留待契约补全后的 SKIN-004）；③把“用户提前删除会话”补进契约缺口记录。
in_scope: apps/worker 渲染与清理 worker 的 defaultJobOptions（attempts、指数退避）与失败状态集成测试（真实 Redis + PostgreSQL）
apps/web 的 skin-preview 解码纯函数（64×64 基础层/overlay 分离，Steve/Alex 语义）与 SkinPreview React 组件（canvas，2D 实现 + 3D 替换接口），fixture 驱动单元测试
docs/STATUS.md 与 docs/development-plan.md 的契约缺口清单补录会话删除操作
out_of_scope: 公共 OpenAPI、JSON Schema 或 SDK 修改（包括候选预览、下载、会话详情/删除的端点实现）
Official 登录、Keycloak、Core 额度、Community 发布、正式 AI 厂商、3D 库选择
生产域名、生产密钥、真实云资源、远程推送
contract_impact: none; preview/download/detail/delete operations remain recorded gaps for the sequential Contracts-primary workstream
acceptance_evidence: Render worker retries retryable provider errors with exponential backoff (attempts=3) and marks the job row FAILED with the provider error code only after retries are exhausted, verified against real Redis and PostgreSQL
Retention cleanup failures retry through BullMQ rather than disappearing
The 2D preview decoder separates base and overlay pixels for a committed 64×64 fixture and the SkinPreview component exposes a swappable renderer interface
The contract gap list includes user-initiated conversation deletion alongside preview, download, conversation detail, and anonymous security mode
pnpm check:full passes end to end
